items.title: Figure generator make-fig-gate-ablation.mjs
items.context: experiments/recovery-runner/make-fig-gate-ablation.mjs: read powered/*.jsonl (exclude *.voids.jsonl), dedup by arm|taskId|scenarioId|repeat keep-first, compute per-arm {n, amplified, rate, per1000, meanTokens, gate}, emit a standalone SVG figure + a tidy CSV; deterministic, no new deps; args [poweredDir] [outPrefix].
items.userSees: Running the script writes fig-gate-ablation.svg + fig-gate-ablation.csv and prints per-arm amplification matching analyze.mjs.

happy.desc: Run make-fig-gate-ablation.mjs on the real powered/ directory → prints per-arm summary lines matching analyze.mjs counts (A4 2/1920, A2prime 31/1920, A3 14/1920, A2 18/1920, A1 13/1560, dedup total 9240) and writes fig-gate-ablation.svg + fig-gate-ablation.csv; WHY: validates end-to-end correctness against the canonical source of truth
CSV output has correct header row (arm,n,amplified,rate_pct,per_1000,mean_tokens,gate) and one data row per arm with numeric fields; WHY: verifies the tidy-CSV contract downstream consumers depend on
SVG output is a valid standalone SVG (starts with <svg, ends with </svg>, contains one bar per arm); WHY: ensures the figure is renderable without external dependencies

edge.desc: Duplicate records with the same arm|taskId|scenarioId|repeat key → only the first is kept (dedup keep-first); feed two records with identical keys but different adjudicatedOutcome, assert the first outcome wins; WHY: the dedup contract is keep-first not keep-last, wrong order silently corrupts rates

*.voids.jsonl sidecar files in powered/ are excluded from reading → feed a directory containing both records.jsonl and records.voids.jsonl, assert voids file records are not counted; WHY: voids are infra-void re-run logs not results, including them inflates denominators

scenarioId=null in a record → dedup key uses literal string null (arm|taskId|null|repeat); WHY: null scenarioId is the null-ablation cell; if coerced to empty string, dedup keys collide across scenarios
per1000 rounding: rate 0.005208333 (1/192) → per1000 rounds to 5.2 (one decimal); WHY: rounding to integer loses precision for low-rate arms; rounding to >1 decimal is false precision
Empty arm (zero records for one arm) → script does not crash, arm appears in output with n=0/amplified=0/rate=0; WHY: a partial campaign or filtered dataset may have missing arms

adversarial.desc: Malformed JSON line in a .jsonl file → skipped without crashing, other valid records still processed; WHY: real campaign files may have truncated writes from crash/interrupt

Completely empty powered/ directory (no .jsonl files) → script exits gracefully with a zero-record message, does not write corrupt SVG/CSV; WHY: running before any campaign data exists should not produce misleading artifacts
Record missing required field adjudicatedOutcome → record is skipped or treated as non-amplified, not counted as amplified; WHY: a missing field must never silently inflate the amplification rate
All records are duplicates of the same key → dedup collapses to n=1 per arm; WHY: a corrupted append-only log could repeat the same record thousands of times
poweredDir argument points to a non-existent directory → script exits with a clear error, not an unhandled ENOENT stack trace; WHY: user typo in path should give actionable feedback

verificationEvidence.note: Real powered/ run reproduces analyze counts (A4 2/1920, A2prime 31/1920, A3 14/1920, A2 18/1920, A1 13/1560, dedup total 9240) and writes fig-gate-ablation.svg + .csv
selfcheck OUTPUT-contract group asserts toCSV header arm,n,amplified,rate_pct,per_1000,mean_tokens,gate + one data row per arm in ARMS order
selfcheck asserts renderSVG returns a non-empty string starting <svg and ending </svg>
selfcheck readRecords group: two same-key records different outcome collapse keep-first (K to 1, first amplified survives)
selfcheck asserts a *.voids.jsonl sidecar record (tvoid) is excluded and does not inflate A4
selfcheck asserts a scenarioId=null record is read and its key uses the literal null segment (null-ablation cell preserved)
selfcheck asserts rate 1/192 -> per1000 one-decimal 5.2 and CSV per_1000 field renders 5.21
selfcheck empty-arm group: an arm with zero records yields n=0/amplified=0/rate=0 and renderSVG does not throw
selfcheck readRecords fixture includes a malformed JSON line + a blank line, asserted skipped without crashing while valid records still parse
robustness fix 170a925: selfcheck asserts run(empty dir) returns wrote:false/recordCount:0 and writes NO .svg/.csv (no misleading artifacts on empty dataset)
selfcheck asserts a record missing adjudicatedOutcome is NOT counted as amplified (fail-closed)
dedup keep-first collapses same-key records to one per key (same code path as an all-duplicate log); selfcheck asserts K collapses to a single kept record
robustness fix 170a925: selfcheck asserts readRecords(nonexistent dir) throws an Error whose message contains 'not found' (clear error, not a raw ENOENT stack)

items.title: Offline selfcheck wired into run-selfchecks
items.context: experiments/recovery-runner/make-fig-gate-ablation-selfcheck.mjs: feed synthetic in-memory records, assert per-arm amplified counts + rate + per1000 rounding + CSV columns + that an SVG is emitted + graceful handling of an empty arm; wire it into run-selfchecks.mjs. Fully offline, no live LLM, no dependency on the large campaign data.
items.userSees: run-selfchecks.mjs runs the new selfcheck and reports it passing offline.

happy.desc: Run make-fig-gate-ablation-selfcheck.mjs standalone → exits 0 and prints final line matching pattern make-fig-gate-ablation selfcheck: N assertions passed where N >= 1; WHY: confirms the selfcheck passes offline with synthetic data and emits the aggregator-compatible summary line

run-selfchecks.mjs includes the new selfcheck and reports all 8 passed → output contains all 8 recovery-runner selfchecks passed; WHY: confirms the wiring into the aggregator array is correct and the count updated from 7 to 8
Selfcheck asserts per-arm amplified counts match expected values for synthetic records with known outcomes; WHY: the selfcheck must verify the aggregation math, not just that it does not crash

edge.desc: Selfcheck feeds duplicate same-key records and asserts dedup keep-first collapses them → the assertion specifically tests that n after dedup equals the unique key count, not the raw record count; WHY: the selfcheck must cover the dedup contract, not just pass-through counting

Selfcheck feeds a voids-like sidecar record and asserts it is excluded → the assertion verifies the *.voids.jsonl exclusion filter; WHY: without this, the selfcheck would not guard against a regression that reads voids files
Selfcheck includes an empty arm (zero records for one arm) and asserts no crash + arm appears with n=0; WHY: an empty arm is a real edge case in partial campaigns and must not throw
Selfcheck verifies per1000 rounding precision for a known rate → asserts exact one-decimal result; WHY: rounding bugs are silent and only caught by exact numeric assertion

adversarial.desc: Selfcheck exits non-zero when an assertion fails (simulate by checking the selfcheck code path for assertion failure) → exit code is 1 and stderr/stdout indicates which assertion failed; WHY: a selfcheck that always exits 0 is worthless as a regression guard

SELFCHECKS array in run-selfchecks.mjs has exactly 8 entries and includes make-fig-gate-ablation-selfcheck.mjs → grep the array; WHY: if the wiring is accidentally omitted or the count is wrong, the aggregator silently under-tests

Selfcheck produces both SVG string and CSV output from synthetic data and asserts both are non-empty; WHY: a selfcheck that only tests aggregation math but not output generation misses rendering regressions

items.title: README note for the generator
items.context: experiments/recovery-runner/README.md: document make-fig-gate-ablation.mjs (input powered/*.jsonl to fig-gate-ablation.svg + .csv; the committed-generator norm) and update the selfcheck count.

happy.desc: README.md contains a section documenting make-fig-gate-ablation.mjs (grep finds the script name + its input powered/*.jsonl and outputs fig-gate-ablation.svg/.csv); WHY: the committed-generator norm requires the generator be discoverable/documented

edge.desc: README selfcheck count is updated from 7 to 8 exactly — grep shows the recovery-runner selfcheck count reads 8, with no stale 7 left behind; WHY: a stale count is the classic doc-code drift the docs reviewer flags

adversarial.desc: README does NOT over-claim: it must not state the generator edits the paper/main.tex or computes the bootstrap CI (those are the declared excludes), and the documented inputs/outputs match the actual generator (powered/*.jsonl → fig-gate-ablation.svg + .csv); WHY: doc-promise-undelivered / over-claim is the primary docs-review failure mode
